ProgressRoot.description: The progress bar: a `<div>` with `role="progressbar"` and the value, range and value text as ARIA attributes. It shares the value, its percentage, the formatted text and the status with the parts inside it, through the `progress` context.

props.value: How much is done, or `null` while that isn't known (indeterminate). A value outside the range is clamped to it; one that isn't finite is indeterminate too.
props.min: The value at which nothing is done.
props.max: The value at which the task is complete.
props.format: `Intl.NumberFormat` options for showing and announcing the value. With them the clamped value is formatted; without, its percentage of the range.
props.locale: The locale the value is formatted in. The browser's locale when left out.
props.getAriaValueText: Returns the text announced for the progress bar, from the formatted value and the raw one (`null` while indeterminate). When it is left out, the formatted value is used, or "indeterminate progress".

dataAttributes.data-indeterminate: Present while the value is `null`: how much is done isn't known.
dataAttributes.data-progressing: Present while the value is known and below `max`.
dataAttributes.data-complete: Present when the value has reached `max`.

ProgressTrack.description: The bar the indicator fills. Give it a height and a background.

ProgressIndicator.description: The filled part of the track. Its inline style sets `width` to the share of the range done, `height: inherit` and `inset-inline-start: 0`. While indeterminate it has no inline style, so the stylesheet decides how it looks.

dataAttributes.data-complete: Present when the value has reached `max`.

ProgressValue.description: The formatted value as text, empty while indeterminate. It is hidden from assistive technology, since the root announces the value. For other text, spread `progressValue(c)` on an element of your own and read the `progress` context.

dataAttributes.data-complete: Present when the value has reached `max`.
